name: PaginationDots
src_typeComment: Plug-and-play pagination dots (the row of dots under a carousel/swiper showing which page you're on). Fully usable standalone (call Setup()/SetCurrentIndex() yourself from any paging system), but built specifically so it "just works" with this toolkit's own paged UI: BindToCardCarousel() and BindToScrollSnap() wire everything in one call — dot count, click-to-jump, and staying in sync as the page changes from either end (a drag, a Next()/Previous() call, or clicking a dot).  Deliberately NOT offering a BindToFancyScrollView(): FancyScrollView is a continuously virtualized scroll (it tracks a scroll OFFSET, not a discrete "current page" index) — there's no clean page concept to put a dot on. If you need dots with FancyScrollView, drive SetCurrentIndex() yourself from whatever page boundary makes sense for your content.

src_serialized.name: dotPrefab
src_serialized.tooltip: Optional custom dot template (needs an Image; add a Button on it too if you want click-to-jump). Leave empty to auto-build plain colored square dots.

src_serialized.name: clickable
src_serialized.tooltip: If true, clicking a dot fires OnDotClicked so you (or a Bind* call) can jump straight to that page.

src_members.name: Setup
src_members.comment: Builds (or rebuilds) one dot per page, centered on this GameObject.

src_members.name: BindToCardCarousel
src_members.comment: One-call setup for the exact pairing this tool was asked to support: dot count and starting page come straight from the carousel, dots stay in sync with Next()/Previous()/drag, and clicking a dot calls the carousel's own GoTo().

src_members.name: BindToScrollSnap
src_members.comment: Same idea for ScrollSnap — ItemCount reads its Content's real child count, OnSnapped keeps dots in sync with drag-to-snap, and clicking a dot calls SnapTo() directly.
